about: The Archive page's first-page thumbnail cutouts for each demo target (25 px, read from a headless page load with IRSA blocked, 15 Nov 2026); tools/prebake_archive.mjs saves them. AI-written (Claude, Anthropic) for team Proper Motion, NASA Space Apps 2026. Saved targets Teegarden's Star and Proxima Centauri (Vega, Sirius and Polaris left out: their thumbnails would take web/prebaked/ past its ~130 MiB budget): read the same way from archive.html?q=<name> on 15 Nov 2026 (IRSA answering), including the page's own image-list requests (SIA + TAP at the SIMBAD position it resolves).
